measurement_contract.available: Non-UNAVAILABLE values after excluding technical execution failures; includes NEUTRAL.
measurement_contract.candidate_confusion: TP/FP/FN/TN over available cases keyed by the positive label: a POSITIVE call is TP on a positive case and FP on a control; an available case without a POSITIVE call is FN on a positive case and TN on a control.
measurement_contract.decisive: POSITIVE or NEGATIVE values only; NEUTRAL is available but not decisive.
measurement_contract.directional_correct: POSITIVE on a positive case or NEGATIVE on a control case.
measurement_contract.directional_wrong: Other decisive values; correct plus wrong equals decisive.
measurement_contract.execution_failed: Statuses other than SUCCESS and DOMAIN_UNAVAILABLE; domain unavailability is not a technical failure.
measurement_contract.interpretation: A decisive/available gap is expected for neutral results, not unexplained sample exclusion. Historical model rationales are claims, not definitions; qualify or challenge obsolete lessons using these rules and the cited measurements.
measurement_contract.paired_population: Both arms use the same frozen case pool. Their availability and decisive subsets may differ with their measurements or thresholds.
measurement_contract.positive_recall: TP divided by (TP plus FN). The paired gate requires at least half of the positive-label check cases to receive a POSITIVE call, so abstaining on positives cannot farm accuracy.
